SET	@prov_c := '%s';
SET @id := '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET	@send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET	@b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET	@start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

DROP TABLE IF  EXISTS tmpz_diag;
CREATE  TEMPORARY TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tmpz_diag (INDEX(HOSPCODE,CID,DATE_SERV)) ENGINE=MyISAM  AS 
(
SELECT d.HOSPCODE,p.CID,d.DATE_SERV 
FROM tmp_diag_opd d INNER JOIN person p ON d.HOSPCODE=p.HOSPCODE AND d.PID=p.PID 														
WHERE d.DATE_SERV BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d  AND  (substr(d.DIAGCODE,1,3) BETWEEN  'I10' AND 'I15') 						
GROUP BY d.HOSPCODE,p.CID,d.DATE_SERV 
) ;

CREATE  TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tmpz_diag2 (INDEX(HOSPCODE,CID,DATE_SERV)) ENGINE=MyISAM  AS  
(SELECT * FROM tmpz_diag);



CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_kpi_ht_visit(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) DEFAULT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
  target int(10) DEFAULT 0,
  result int(10) DEFAULT 0,
  target1 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
  result1 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
  target2 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
  result2 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
  target3 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
  result3 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
  target4 int(10) DEFAULT 0,
  result4 int(10) DEFAULT 0,

	PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_kpi_ht_visit WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_kpi_ht_visit 
(
SELECT SQL_BIG_RESULT @id,tb1.h1 HOSPCODE,concat(h.provcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.distcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.subdistcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode
			,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543

		,sum(if(tb1.rs='b',tb1.cnt,0)) b,sum(if(tb1.rs='a',tb1.cnt,0)) a
		,sum(if(tb1.rs1='b',tb1.cnt1,0)) b1,sum(if(tb1.rs1='a',tb1.cnt1,0)) a1
		,sum(if(tb1.rs2='b',tb1.cnt2,0)) b2,sum(if(tb1.rs2='a',tb1.cnt2,0)) a2
		,sum(if(tb1.rs3='b',tb1.cnt3,0)) b3,sum(if(tb1.rs3='a',tb1.cnt3,0)) a3
		,sum(if(tb1.rs4='b',tb1.cnt4,0)) b4,sum(if(tb1.rs4='a',tb1.cnt4,0)) a4
FROM
(
SELECT tb01.h1,'a' rs,count(tb01.h1) cnt
			,'a' rs1,sum(if(tb01.m BETWEEN '10' AND '12',1,0)) cnt1
			,'a' rs2,sum(if(tb01.m BETWEEN '01' AND '03',1,0)) cnt2
			,'a' rs3,sum(if(tb01.m BETWEEN '04' AND '06',1,0)) cnt3
			,'a' rs4,sum(if(tb01.m BETWEEN '07' AND '09',1,0)) cnt4
FROM
(
SELECT SQL_BIG_RESULT  t.hospcode h1,t.cid,d.HOSPCODE h2,d.DATE_SERV,DATE_FORMAT(d.DATE_SERV,'%m') m
FROM t_dmht t INNER JOIN tmpz_diag d ON t.hospcode=d.HOSPCODE and  t.cid=d.CID  
WHERE t.typearea IN(1,3)
GROUP BY d.HOSPCODE,d.CID,d.DATE_SERV
ORDER BY t.hospcode,t.cid,d.DATE_SERV
) tb01
GROUP BY tb01.h1

UNION

SELECT tb02.h1,'b' rs,count(tb02.h1) cnt 
	,'b' rs1,sum(if(tb02.m BETWEEN '10' AND '12',1,0)) cnt1
	,'b' rs2,sum(if(tb02.m BETWEEN '01' AND '03',1,0)) cnt2
	,'b' rs3,sum(if(tb02.m BETWEEN '04' AND '06',1,0)) cnt3
	,'b' rs4,sum(if(tb02.m BETWEEN '07' AND '09',1,0)) cnt4
FROM
(
SELECT SQL_BIG_RESULT t1.h1,t1.hmain,d.HOSPCODE h2,d.CID,d.DATE_SERV,DATE_FORMAT(d.DATE_SERV,'%m') m
FROM tmpz_diag2 d INNER JOIN 
(
SELECT SQL_BIG_RESULT  t.hospcode h1,t.cid,c.hmain
FROM t_dmht t INNER JOIN cmastercup c ON t.hospcode=c.hsub 
WHERE c.province_id=concat(@prov_c,'00') AND t.typearea IN(1,3)
ORDER BY t.hospcode,t.cid
) t1 ON t1.hmain=d.HOSPCODE AND t1.cid=d.CID 
GROUP BY d.HOSPCODE,d.CID,d.DATE_SERV
ORDER BY t1.h1,t1.cid,d.DATE_SERV
) tb02
GROUP BY tb02.h1
) tb1
INNER JOIN chospital h ON tb1.h1=h.hoscode
WHERE h.provcode=@prov_c 
GROUP BY  tb1.h1 
)
;

DROP TABLE tmpz_diag;
DROP TABLE tmpz_diag2;

hospital.label: โรงพยาบาล
hospital.query: SELECT hoscode as areacode, hosname as areaname, SUM(target) as target, SUM(result) as result, SUM(target1) as targetq1, SUM(result1) as resultq1, SUM(target2) as targetq2, SUM(result2) as resultq2, SUM(target3) as targetq3, SUM(result3) as resultq3, SUM(target4) as targetq4, SUM(result4) as resultq4 FROM {{S_TABLE}} s LEFT JOIN chospital_regis ON s.hospcode = chospital_regis.hoscode and hostype IN ('5', '6', '7', '11', '12', '15') WHERE s.id = {{REPORT_ID}} AND LEFT(s.areacode, 2) not IN ('99') AND b_year = {{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} AND ( chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or {{PROVINCE_CODE}} = 'ALL' ) AND ( amp_code = {{DISTRICT_CODE}} or {{DISTRICT_CODE}} = 'ALL' ) AND ( tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_CODE}} or {{SUBDISTRICT_CODE}} = 'ALL' ) AND ( dep IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or {{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}} = 'ALL' ) AND ( dep = ({{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) or {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} = 'ALL' ) AND ( s.hospcode = ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or {{HOSPITAL_CODE}} = 'ALL' ) AND ( mcode = ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or {{MINISTRY_CODE}} = 'ALL' ) GROUP BY hoscode, hosname

cup.query: SELECT ar_code as areacode, ar_name as areaname, SUM(target) as target, SUM(result) as result, SUM(target1) as targetq1, SUM(result1) as resultq1, SUM(target2) as targetq2, SUM(result2) as resultq2, SUM(target3) as targetq3, SUM(result3) as resultq3, SUM(target4) as targetq4, SUM(result4) as resultq4 FROM {{S_TABLE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON {{S_TABLE}}.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN ( SELECT hoscode as ar_code, hosname as ar_name, chospital_regis.* FROM chospital_regis ) chospital_regis ON chospital_regis.hoscode = {{S_TABLE}}.hospcode INNER JOIN cmastercup ON chospital_regis.hoscode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE {{S_TABLE}}.id = {{REPORT_ID}} AND LEFT({{S_TABLE}}.areacode, 2) not IN ('99') AND b_year = {{YEAR}} AND ( chospital_regis.provcode = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} ) AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} AND ( zone_code = ({{ZONE_CODE}}) or {{ZONE_CODE}} = 'ALL' ) AND ( amp_code = {{DISTRICT_CODE}} or {{DISTRICT_CODE}} = 'ALL' ) AND ( tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_CODE}} or {{SUBDISTRICT_CODE}} = 'ALL' ) AND ( ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} ) AND ( dep IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or {{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}} = 'ALL' ) AND ( dep = ({{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) or {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} = 'ALL' ) AND ( cmastercup.hmain = {{HOSPITAL_CODE}} OR {{HOSPITAL_CODE}} = 'ALL' ) AND ( mcode = ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or {{MINISTRY_CODE}} = 'ALL' ) GROUP BY ar_code, ar_name

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT ar_code as areacode, ar_name as areaname, SUM(target) as target, SUM(result) as result, SUM(target1) as targetq1, SUM(result1) as resultq1, SUM(target2) as targetq2, SUM(result2) as resultq2, SUM(target3) as targetq3, SUM(result3) as resultq3, SUM(target4) as targetq4, SUM(result4) as resultq4 FROM {{S_TABLE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON {{S_TABLE}}.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN ( SELECT z.zonecode as ar_code, zonename as ar_name, changwatcode as l_code FROM cchangwat c INNER JOIN czone z ON c.zonecode = z.zonecode WHERE c.zonecode not in ('99') ORDER BY l_code ) as ar ON left({{S_TABLE}}.areacode, 2) = ar.l_code LEFT JOIN chospital_regis ON {{S_TABLE}}.hospcode = chospital_regis.hoscode INNER JOIN ( SELECT hoscode as hcode FROM chospital_regis INNER JOIN cchangwat ON chospital_regis.provcode = cchangwat.changwatcode WHERE chospital_regis.hdc_regist = 1 AND chospital_regis.status = '1' GROUP BY hoscode ) sp ON {{S_TABLE}}.hospcode = sp.hcode WHERE {{S_TABLE}}.id = {{REPORT_ID}} AND LEFT({{S_TABLE}}.areacode, 2) not IN ('99') AND b_year = {{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} AND ( zone_code = ({{ZONE_CODE}}) or {{ZONE_CODE}} = 'ALL' ) AND ( chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or {{PROVINCE_CODE}} = 'ALL' ) AND ( amp_code = {{DISTRICT_CODE}} or {{DISTRICT_CODE}} = 'ALL' ) AND ( tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_CODE}} or {{SUBDISTRICT_CODE}} = 'ALL' ) AND ( ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} ) AND ( dep IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or {{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}} = 'ALL' ) AND ( dep = ({{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) or {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} = 'ALL' ) AND ( {{S_TABLE}}.hospcode = ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or {{HOSPITAL_CODE}} = 'ALL' ) AND ( mcode = ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or {{MINISTRY_CODE}} = 'ALL' ) GROUP BY ar_code, ar_name order by ar_code
